domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record could be retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report splits are not public for this entity in the sources reachable: DuckDuckGo search backend returned "Connection refused" on both queries, and zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com and indiamart.com all returned HTTP 403/429. The ImportKey page shows only customs (cross-border) records and no domestic GST or contract data. No domestic figure is asserted; turnover and domestic split = null.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: one dated outbound customs record (2026-01-08, Kolkata ACC -> Bangkok, Thailand, HS 84749000, B/L 8596397) plus five named foreign buyers with shipment counts, so the company does export. Important HS discrepancy: the declared HS 843139 (parts of machinery of 8425-8430) does not match any observed record. Observed codes are 84749000 (parts of machinery of 8474, screening/separating plant) on the export line and 84133090 / 84139190 (pumps and pump parts) and 39095000 (polyurethane prepolymer) on the import lines. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual code should be corrected to 84749000 for the export flow, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Profile is consistent with a trader/manufacturer_trader of mineral-processing and slurry-pump equipment rather than a steel producer, despite the claimed metallurgy industry: it imports Chinese slurry pumps, pump casings and polyurethane prepolymer and re-exports PU panels. Domestic supply evidence: none found in reachable sources, so domestic_status is unknown rather than confirmed or none_found - this is a tooling limitation (search backend down, registry sites blocked), not proof of absence. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in the free views.
